about.headline: The Story of Hayat Trove
paragraphs: Hayat Trove was born from a genuine passion for flowers and a belief that every arrangement is a work of art deserving of care and mastery. In the heart of Al-Wurood District in Tabuk, we select each bloom with an expert eye and craft it into a masterpiece that pulses with life.

We believe flowers are more than a gift -- they are a sincere message that conveys emotions words cannot express. From joy to solace, from celebration to gratitude, we shape nature into the most honest expression of feeling.
Our team of professional arrangers combines refined taste with deep expertise, delivering arrangements that exceed your expectations every time.

values.title: Uncompromising Quality
values.description: We select only the finest natural flowers from the best sources.

values.title: Renewed Creativity
values.description: Every arrangement is unique, inspired by the latest global floral art trends.

values.title: Personal Attention
values.description: We treat every order with personal care as if it were our own occasion.
